notes: Draft configuration selected from the independently named circuit relation 280443. The source route passes timing and course-distance checks. Layout identity and travel direction still require visual review.
Source one-way tags are preserved. Relation routes can follow a race-day direction different from ordinary road use; travel direction is provisional.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 78 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: Original borders contain pavement-crossing spikes or local self-crossings at the pinned defect vertices. The native licensed image, full appearance-estimator overlay and original defect crop were reviewed against the retained source route. The complete automatic replacement remains estimated, with image sampling, shadows, shoulders, paint and access-opening uncertainty. It is not a surveyed barrier or an independent manual measurement recipe.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
